svg.title: HomeBrain Universal Sensor Carrier v1.0
svg.text: Front/component side • USB edge left • keyed JST-XH ports • XIAO plugs into two 1×7 sockets
Why this fixes the fan-out problem
Each XIAO pin enters exactly one socket contact. Copper on this PCB fans power, ground, SDA and SCL out
to separate keyed ports. No XIAO hole ever contains two wires, and every sensor harness can be unplugged.
Red = front copper • Blue = back copper • Gold = plated through-hole • Yellow = antenna copper keep-out
1. Solder the two 1×7 sockets perfectly vertical.
2. Solder all keyed headers with pin 1 at the round silk dot.
3. Populate R1/R2 only on Climate; both are 200 kΩ 1%.
4. Plug the XIAO in component-side up, USB toward the arrow.
5. Meter-check GND↔GND and confirm no 3V3↔5V short.
6. On Climate, verify battery polarity before inserting J6/J7.
Short TP1 to TP2/GND during boot for 1.5 seconds.
Top: D0, D1, D2, D3, SDA, SCL, TX
Bottom: VBUS, GND, 3V3, D10, D9, D8, RX
D10/D9/D8 remain electrically isolated on this board.
